_metadata.description: Scenarios self-register the backup targets they own, idempotently and reconstructably.

requirements.title: Idempotent target registration keyed by owner+name
requirements.description: RegisterTarget upserts a target spec keyed by (owner, name). Re-registering with the same key updates the spec to the new desired state rather than creating a duplicate; an unchanged re-register is a no-op.

validation.notes: Register, re-register identical (no-op), re-register changed (update); assert single row and latest spec.

requirements.title: Deregistration and reconstructable catalog
requirements.description: DeregisterTarget removes a target; orphan targets (owner no longer present) are detectable. The catalog is reconstructable because owning scenarios re-register on boot, so the manager DB is a cache + run history, not a single source of truth.

validation.notes: Deregister removes target; rebuild catalog from a fresh re-register sequence and assert equivalence.
